project.name: Kernel Creature Tournament (system game)
project.purpose: Council-driven single-elimination team duel: trainers and creatures are Council roles, the game engine resolves every exchange from their bounded answers. Moves, actions, storyboard frames, rigs, palette and texts are editable game content.

consequence.then: ASCII team reveal completed; bracket initialized by the LocalGPT tournament engine.
consequence.else: Bracket initialized by the LocalGPT tournament engine.

subtitle.then: ASCII Team Artist reveal complete. Bracket initialized; LocalGPT still owns every tournament consequence.
subtitle.else: Bracket initialized. The AI participants provide bounded commands and voice; LocalGPT owns every tournament consequence.

consequence.then: Match resolved: trainer {winner.owner} and team advance; trainer {loser.owner} is eliminated from this fictional bracket.
consequence.else: Exchange resolved: {left.member} {left.health} HP ({left.team} team); {right.member} {right.health} HP ({right.team} team).

complete.consequence: Tournament complete. {champion.member} receives the imaginary ceremonial prize.
complete.subtitle: Tournament complete. {champion.member} receives the imaginary ceremonial prize.

parameters.headline: ROUND {round} // MATCH GREETING

parameters.headline: ENGINE IMPACT

parameters.headline: RECOVERY / BENCH
parameters.body: Switched-out and reserve creatures remain in the team roster and rest between exchanges.

asset.prompt: The arena needs a battle sprite for the creature "{{Entrant.member.name}}" (species: {{Entrant.member.species}}; form: {{Entrant.member.form}}). {{AssetDrawer}}

Draw one front-facing creature: 8 to 16 rows, 8 to 20 characters per row, one row per line. Use only these pixel characters: . empty, # outline, + main body, - shading, * accent marking, o eye. Give it a closed # outline and at least one o eye. Its shape must clearly differ from these sprites already in the arena; do not copy or mirror them:
Output these lines and nothing else:
COLORS: body=N shade=N accent=N eye=N outline=N
followed directly by your sprite rows.
texts.asset.drawer.self: You are this creature: draw yourself. Your introduction had no usable sprite, or one too similar to another creature's.
texts.asset.drawer.artist: You draw this sprite for the creature member {{AssetMemberModel}}, which did not deliver a usable one. Draw the creature as described, not yourself.
